notes: Normalized captures of development-only experiments, not production validation.
Organization, project, feed, instance IDs, package names, versions and dates are synthetic.
Synthetic content bytes, content hashes, public protocol resource IDs and wire structures are retained.
Raw live-only records and approvals are retained privately, not in this repository.

reference_publish.capture_method: Per-process DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS diagnostic subscription; TLS verification unchanged.
reference_publish.proof_encoding: base64 serialized nodes: file-tree node, then super-root

local_sdk_evidence.method: Public installed ArtifactTool SDK APIs with a terminal in-memory HttpMessageHandler; no network, no real receipts, no implementation disassembly.
local_sdk_evidence.chunk_header: X-ms-chunk-{id}: {length}/false for uncompressed bytes, in concatenated request-body order
local_sdk_evidence.retention_dates: X-MS-KeepUntils is a comma-separated UTC timestamp list in serialized child order
local_sdk_evidence.retention_summary: X-MS-Signature is base64(SHA256(concatenated child receipt signatures in serialized child order)); verified for one and two synthetic receipts
local_sdk_evidence.capture_correction: The second capture classified some length/false strings as opaque base64 because they happen to use the base64 alphabet. No omitted value was retroactively manufactured.
local_sdk_evidence.chunker_cases_include: Empty, small, min/max chunk sizes, exact 1 MiB boundaries, short reads, all-zero runs, and zero/random transitions

unresolved_contracts: Development-only native smoke and public-tool package roundtrips were verified; this does not establish production reliability.

Write failures and ambiguous registration remain covered by offline fault injection rather than deliberately induced live faults. Nonempty InsufficientKeepUntil and rich node acknowledgments were observed during Bicep retention diagnosis.
More-than-512-file collection proofs and chunked manifests have offline coverage, not a captured ArtifactTool registration.
Only the observed legacy dedup endpoint is implemented; other domain/session transfer protocols are not claimed.

bicep_retention_discovery.meaning: Requested node receipt plus all unique immediate child receipts; not an empty success and not unrelated descendant receipts.
bicep_retention_discovery.fix: Accept only the requested node and immediate child receipt IDs, require a positive unexpired requested-node receipt, and preserve stronger cached retention proofs across shared subtrees.
bicep_retention_discovery.regression: tests/test_bicep_retention.py constructs synthetic IDs and receipts matching the observed 512-reference, 510-unique-child acknowledgment shape.
